question: Find the display name of the owner of the highest-scoring child post (i.e., a post with a non-null ParentId) that was last edited by a user who also earned a 'Teacher' badge in 2013 and has posted at least one comment with a score of 0.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
JOIN postHistory ph ON p.XCL_026 = ph.XCL_014
JOIN users u2 ON ph.XCL_017 = u2.XCL_052
WHERE p.XCL_043 IS NOT NULL
  AND u2.XCL_052 IN (
    SELECT b.XCL_002
    FROM badges b
    WHERE b.XCL_003 = 'Teacher'
      AND b.XCL_004 >= '2013-01-01'
      AND b.XCL_004 < '2014-01-01'
  )
  AND u2.XCL_052 IN (
    SELECT c.XCL_010
    FROM comments c
    WHERE c.XCL_007 = 0
  )
ORDER BY p.XCL_031 DESC
LIMIT 1
